description: Checks layer separation and evidence limits when using epanetparser.

evals.label: Separate parse, static, and simulation findings
evals.prompt: The epanetparser report contains an INP parse error, a static warning, and no simulation output. Summarize what was checked and what was not.
evals.expected_output: A report that separates the parse failure and static warning, states that no simulation was run, and makes no calibration or field-validity claim.
assertions: The report distinguishes structural parsing, static rules, and simulation checks.
The report does not claim calibration or field validity.

evals.label: Do not claim a check when the tool is unavailable
evals.prompt: Validate this EPANET model with epanetparser. The command is not installed in the environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the tool is unavailable, asks before installing dependencies, and does not claim the model was checked.
assertions: The agent does not claim that parsing or validation occurred.
The agent asks before installing the external tool or its dependencies.

evals.label: Route network scenario analysis to WNTR engineering
evals.prompt: Use WNTR to compare a baseline and user-specified pump-outage scenario, including pressure and demand results.
evals.expected_output: The captured text signals wntr-engineering for model scenario analysis rather than native input parsing/static checks.
